caption: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning.
model_annotation: This figure presents three separate pie charts illustrating the distribution of quantifiers and operations across three categories: Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive. The first pie chart, titled 'Categorical,' contains four slices: Universal Quantifiers at 29.07% shown in light blue, Negation at 27.91% shown in orange, Limiter at 27.91% shown in pink, and Existential Quantifiers at 15.12% shown in light green. The slices are arranged roughly in descending order of size, with Universal Quantifiers being the largest and Existential Quantifiers the smallest. The second pie chart, titled 'Approximate Number Generation,' contains three slices: Approximate Quantities at 45.03% shown in light yellow, Comparative Relationships at 36.26% shown in light blue, and Absolute Absence at 18.71% shown in light lavender/beige. These slices are ordered from largest to smallest. The third pie chart, titled 'Disjunctive & Conjunctive,' contains two nearly equal slices: Conjunctive at 50.49% shown in light pink/mauve and Disjunctive at 49.51% shown in a slightly different shade of light pink/lavender. All three charts display percentage labels and category labels directly on the slices, and none of the charts include a separate legend. No slices appear to be visually exploded or offset from the main chart body.
